slot.brief: Simple two-word analogy pair (e.g., 'Doctor : Hospital') with four analogous pairs; all four options should be recognisable noun-profession/place relations.

stem:

NURSE : HOSPITAL ::

verdicts.working: A nurse works in a hospital; similarly, a teacher works in a school.

working:
A nurse works in a hospital — a worker-to-workplace relation. 'Teacher : School' shows the same relation. B links a worker to a thing used, C to the crop/product, and D to the person served, so none of them matches.

Independent check: A nurse works in a hospital; similarly, a teacher works in a school.
solution: A nurse works in a hospital; similarly, a teacher works in a school. Both pairs express a worker-to-workplace relationship.
